model_annotation_placeholder: Describe the bodies an AI agent should mark for each class, and what to leave out.
model_area_dish_description: Find the dish in each photo. AI annotation, training and detection then keep to the dish and its rim; a photo with no dish found is used whole.
model_counted_classes_description: A new observation counts these classes unless it chooses its own. Observations already made keep theirs.
models_description: Each model names the classes it counts; its datasets train ever more accurate versions.
models_empty_description: Create a model to name the classes it counts.
version_dialog_effect: Once current, the observation photos of this model are counted again by it; reviewed and AI-proposed counts stay as they are. Any other version can be chosen back at any time, and its counts return at once without reading again.

match.countPlural=one: {formattedCount} image could not be read and is left out of the comparison.
match.countPlural=other: {formattedCount} images could not be read and are left out of the comparison.

match.hasCurrent=no, countPlural=one: Compared with the reviewers' counts on {formattedCount} reviewed image this version never trained on. Lower error is better. This model has no current version yet; only this version's results are shown.
match.hasCurrent=no, countPlural=other: Compared with the reviewers' counts on {formattedCount} reviewed images this version never trained on. Lower error is better. This model has no current version yet; only this version's results are shown.
match.hasCurrent=*, countPlural=one: Compared with the reviewers' counts on {formattedCount} reviewed image this version never trained on. Lower error is better.
match.hasCurrent=*, countPlural=other: Compared with the reviewers' counts on {formattedCount} reviewed images this version never trained on. Lower error is better.

version_dialog_images_description: Version columns show the difference from the reviewers' count; the images either version miscounts most come first.
version_dialog_no_comparison: This version has no held-out validation images, so it cannot be compared with the current one.

match.candidate=*: Still reading: this version {formattedCandidate}/{formattedTotal}, current version {formattedCurrent}/{formattedTotal}. Results count only the images both have read.

version_dialog_unfound_classes: This version does not find {classes}; they count zero in what it reads.
version_dialog_waiting: The comparison appears here once the images are read, which needs a Worker online.
versions_empty_description: A version appears here when a training run succeeds.
